0.heading: Overview
refs: Psa 118:1 , An exhortation to praise God for his mercy
Psa 118:5 , The psalmist by his experience shews how good it is to trust in God

1.heading: AM 2962, BC 1042 Title
refs: This Psalm was probably composed by David after Nathan's prophetic address
and sung by alternate choirs at some public festival. It largely partakes of David's spirit, and everywhere shews the hand of a master
the style is grand and sublime
the subject noble and majestic. Psa 118:29
1.body:
This Psalm was probably composed by David after Nathan's prophetic address; and sung by alternate choirs at some public festival. It largely partakes of David's spirit, and everywhere shews the hand of a master; the style is grand and sublime; the subject noble and majestic. Psa 118:29 ; 103:17 ; 106:1 ; 107:1 ; 136:1
